title: Petition of Tennessee Gas Pipeline Company, requesting authority from the Department of Public Utilities, pursuant to Chapter 164, Section 75C for the right to exercise the power of eminent domain under Chapter 79 of the G.L. for the right to take by eminent domain such rights-of-way, permanent easements, temporary easements, or such other interests in land or other property necessary for the construction, operation, maintenance, alteration, or removal of natural gas transmission pipeline, appliances, appurtenances, and other equipment situated in the Towns of Burlington and Wilmington in the County of Middlesex, Massachusetts.
